page.notes: The page number is printed in old style and is read as 584; the first digit is uncertain. The running head ends in a worn "M." The entries "ad-" (line 3) and "Stipul-" (line 36) are hyphenated at the line end, and the hyphens are taken from the scan. Several section numbers and letters are faint or blurred, mainly in the lower right, so they may be misread. The right edge shows part of the facing page; it is not transcribed.
